info.title: vLLM CI Dashboard API
info.description: Public read-only API backing https://ci.vllm.ai. All documented GET endpoints are unauthenticated and return JSON; errors use `{ "error": string }`. Responses are cached via `Vercel-CDN-Cache-Control`; treat data as eventually consistent (30s-10min staleness).

get.description: Fast Failure Events from the last 7 days, newest first, max 500.
Up to 30 analyzed comparisons of consecutive scheduled Full CI runs, newest first.
Open alerts plus alerts resolved in the last 30 days, max 500. Responds with schemaStatus "pending" and empty alerts when the alerting tables are not migrated yet.
Paginated Buildkite builds with pass/fail summary and duration history. Group and job details are served by `/api/builds/groups` and `/api/builds/jobs`.

get.summary: List available pipeline and branch filter options
get.description: Branches only cover builds from the last 30 days.
jobsByBuild encodes jobs as [jobNames index, state] pairs; jobNames is the shared dictionary. Empty buildIds returns an empty payload, not a 400.

get.summary: Expanded job lists per build and group
get.description: Missing buildIds or groups returns an empty payload, not a 400.

get.summary: Compact build summary for agents and CLI use
get.description: Defaults to a text/plain summary; pass format=json for JSON.

get.summary: OTel span lanes for a single CI build
get.description: available=false with empty lanes when the build has no spans. Whole-build views cap at 5000 spans; job detail pages at 2000.
